national_news.title: Nation observes Partition Horrors Remembrance Day
bullets: The nation is paying homage to those who sacrificed their lives and suffered during the partition in 1947.
The Government observes 14th August every year as Partition Horrors Remembrance Day.
Programmes are being organised across the country to commemorate the day.

national_news.title: Iga Swiatek beats Elena Rybakina to claim Women’s Singles title at Canadian Open Tennis
bullets: Iga Swiatek of Poland won the Women’s Singles title in Toronto with a 6-2 6-3 win over Elena Rybakina.
Ben Shelton won the Men’s Singles title in Montreal by defeating Brandon Nakashima with a score of 6-3, 7-6(4).
Iga Swiatek captured her first title of the season, giving her a confidence boost heading into the US Open.

national_news.title: Kashmiri diaspora protests against state-sponsored terror in PoJK
bullets: Kashmiri diaspora groups protested in Belgium, Italy, and the UK against alleged abuses by Pakistani security forces in PoJK.
The protests called for international scrutiny of the situation in PoJK and support for the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC).
The unrest in PoJK has taken an international turn, with the Kashmiri diaspora seeking global attention to the issue.

national_news.title: UNSC links Delhi Red Fort suicide car bombing to Al-Qaida in Indian Subcontinent
bullets: The UNSC's Analytical Support and Sanctions Monitoring Team attributed the Red Fort suicide car bombing to Al-Qaida in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS).
AQIS has evolved into a regional terrorist entity with established logistics and financial networks.
The report highlights AQIS's decentralized and scattered operational structure.

national_news.title: Iran refutes President Trump’s claim of seizing Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi rejected US President Donald Trump's claim of total control over the Strait of Hormuz.
Mr. Araghchi accused the US of making miscalculations due to intelligence failures over the strategic waterway.
Iran has rejected Mr. Trump's claims, stating that the US does not have control over the Strait of Hormuz.

national_news.title: India wins 35 medals, including 13 gold, at Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India emerged as the overall champions at the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
The Indian contingent secured thirteen gold, eight silver, and fourteen bronze medals at the event.
Senior Indian fencers claimed five gold medals in six events on the fourth and final day of the competition.

national_news.title: Country's exports register robust growth of over 13% in July
bullets: Total exports, including merchandise and services, estimated at 80.14 billion US dollars in July this year.
Merchandise shipments jumped over 19.6% to 44.24 billion US dollars from a year earlier.
Growth in merchandise exports driven by petroleum products, electronic goods, engineering goods, and organic and inorganic chemicals.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog highlights 12 priority sectors to make India a global manufacturing hub
bullets: NITI Aayog has identified 12 priority sectors for India to become a global manufacturing hub.
The sectors include automobiles, electronics, steel, capital goods, defence and drones, chemicals, solar PV, textiles, pharmaceuticals, and more.
The report aims to strengthen India's manufacturing ecosystem and support the vision of Viksit Bharat.

national_news.title: Global Crude Oil Prices Decline Due to Weaker Demand and Higher US Stocks
bullets: Brent crude price fell 1.8% to $87.41 per barrel
West Texas Intermediate crude price fell 1.9% to $81.65 per barrel
US commercial crude oil inventories increased by 17.4 million barrels to 424.4 million barrels

national_news.title: Digital Rupee for DBT under PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana to be launched in Chandigarh
bullets: The Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) – Digital Rupee (e₹) will be launched for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under PMGKAY.
Chandigarh will be the first Union Territory in the country to undertake a full-fledged roll-out of the Digital Rupee.
This initiative marks the next evolution by the Government of India in welfare delivery, shifting from physical distribution to purpose-bound digital delivery.

national_news.title: Nation celebrates 80th Independence Day by organising Tiranga rallies
bullets: NCC Maharashtra organised a rally with 1500 cadets from schools and colleges across Mumbai to celebrate India's 80th Independence Day.
The rally showcased patriotism, youth power, and national pride, with cadets marching to the tunes of Vande Mataram and waving the Tiranga.
The event was part of NCC Maharashtra's Independence Day campaign, which includes rallies and community activities across the state.

national_news.title: India Building Capabilities in Semiconductor and AI Technologies
bullets: India is building capabilities in semiconductor design and fabrication to computing infrastructure and indigenous AI models.
Government initiatives are being taken across both semiconductor and AI technologies to recognize their convergence.
Semiconductors are the foundation of modern technology, powering everything from smartphones and vehicles to satellites and AI systems.

national_news.title: President Murmu presents Sangeet Natak Akademi fellowships, awards to over 100 artists
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu conferred the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships and Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards on eminent artists for 2024 and 2025.
The ceremony was held at Vigyan Bhawan in Delhi.
Over 100 artists received the fellowships and awards.

national_news.title: India's Energy Landscape Evolves to Meet Rising Demand and Strengthen Energy Security
bullets: India is transforming its energy landscape to meet rising demand while strengthening energy security and supporting a cleaner future.
The transformation spans renewable energy, nuclear power, petroleum, natural gas, coal, and emerging technologies.
India is expanding non-fossil energy capacity, strengthening domestic energy resources, and developing new technologies for the future.

national_news.title: PIB Hyderabad workshop seeks to dispel myths around organ donation
bullets: PIB Hyderabad organised a workshop on organ donation to highlight common myths and medical facts.
Experts stressed the importance of donor families, public awareness, and voluntary pledges.
NOTTO's Jug Jug Jiyo campaign aims to encourage organ donation.

national_news.title: Monsoon Session of Parliament Adjourns Sine Die; 12 Bills Passed by both Houses of Parliament
bullets: The Monsoon Session, 2026 of Parliament was adjourned sine die on Thursday, the 13th of August, 2026.
A total of 12 Bills were passed by both Houses of Parliament during the Session.
The Session provided 19 sittings spread over a period of 25 days.

national_news.title: Organ donation gives new lease of life: Dr Sree Bhushan Raju
bullets: Organ donation is a noble act that gives a new lease of life to those in need of transplants.
Dr Sree Bhushan Raju highlights the importance of organ donation in saving lives.
The article emphasizes the need for awareness and education on organ donation.

national_news.title: NCSC to Review Union Government's Handling of Posts Reserved for Scheduled Caste Candidates
bullets: NCSC Chairperson Kishor Makwana has raised concerns over filling reserved posts with unreserved candidates.
The National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC) will review the Union government's handling of posts reserved for Scheduled Caste candidates.
This move aims to ensure that the rights of Scheduled Caste communities are protected and their reserved positions are filled as per the law.

national_news.title: Stage set for 80th Independence Day Celebrations at Red Fort
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will lead the 80th Independence Day Celebrations from the Red Fort in Delhi on August 15, 2026.
The grand event is set to commemorate 150 years of the enduring national song 'Vande Mataram' and 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047'.
'Vande Mataram' will be rendered for the first time as part of the celebrations.

national_news.title: Assam is India's third-largest rubber-producing state
bullets: Assam ranks third in rubber production in India, after Kerala and Tripura.
India is a major producer and consumer of natural rubber.
Rubber is an elastic, flexible, and resilient material produced from the rubber tree.

national_news.title: Ahmedabad Metro Phase Three Secures PIB Clearance
bullets: Ahmedabad Metro Phase Three has secured clearance from the Public Investment Board (PIB).
This development is a significant step towards the construction of the metro phase.
The project aims to improve the city's transportation infrastructure.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog Report on Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub
bullets: NITI Aayog has released a report on key sectors to position India as a global manufacturing hub.
The report aims to strengthen India's manufacturing aspirations and drive the country's growth story.
The report identifies key sectors that will play a strategic role in positioning India as a global manufacturing hub.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Get World Trade Centre in Patna: CM
bullets: The Bihar government plans to build a World Trade Centre in Patna.
The project aims to make Bihar a leading inland fish-producing state by 2030.
The state government will focus on value addition from production to enhance the overall value chain.
